units: All reading, provenance and disposition counts are unique CVEs. Article files are separately counted. One source may cover multiple CVEs; one CVE may have multiple sources.

definitions.full-technical-text: At least one whole relevant technical report, source file, patch, test, or manual text explicitly read; may be ineligible or a version-only probe. Not admission, exhaustive source coverage, all helpers/binaries audited, or runtime reproduction.
definitions.selected-technical-sections-only: Relevant technical portions read; no complete relevant technical unit certified.
definitions.existing-wiki-body-only: Only wiki body/news/summary/navigation reading certified; complete technical archive belongs to full with archive-only provenance.
definitions.bounded-search-advisory-only: CNA/search/advisory/metadata or discovery reading only; downloading/hash/machine scanning is not technical full reading.
definitions.platform-blocked: Current explicit cybersecurity-blockedscope only; stale historical reading limits preserved separately.
definitions.unread: No accepted content-reading/search record in current completed accounting scopes; inventory metadata is not reading credit.
definitions.non-wiki-technical-source-text: Complete non-wiki report/code/patch/test source text certified. Includes canonical third-party tools and rejected candidate code where read. Does not universally mean first-disclosure research or origin bytes verified. Owner-specific narrower provenance is retained per claim.
definitions.primary-web-text-cache-origin-bytes-unve: Complete original-publisher technical text read through cached web-tool representation, without original byte verification.
definitions.explicit-prior-source-audit-reuse: An explicitly attributed prior source review is relied upon; do not label a new direct source read.
definitions.full-technical-wiki-archive-only: Only a complete technical wiki/archive unit supports full depth; no nonarchive complete source credit.
definitions.published: Qualified material present in this PR branch; not a claim this draft PR has merged into master.

limits: Full technical reading is not a PoC eligibility verdict, exhaustive source review, dependency/binary audit or runtime reproduction.
Site failures, login walls, dynamic shells and cancelled source-fetch processes are not automatically platform cybersecurity blocks.
The blocked scope is165year2023 CVEs and50year2024 desktop/browser CVEs. No retry or rerouting has been used to complete that blocked scope.
The frozen accounting still has995unread2011–2022 CVEs. Later assignment does not count as actual reading.
